name: luhm-os
description: Evidence-gated LuHm OS workflow with Lum/Oni routing, proof inspection, and read-only MCP-backed ChatGPT plugin support.

interface.longDescription: Use Lum as the single orchestrator for bounded read-only Oni workflows, exact-source inspection, proof-aware status, and scope validation without granting merge, release, signing, or publication authority to the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Use LuHm OS to inspect the current source truth and explain what is actually proven.
Use LuHm OS to list the Lum and Oni roles and their current bounded capabilities.
Use LuHm OS to validate this read-only task scope before routing it.
